earnings.title: LUMENTUM ANNOUNCES FIRST QUARTER OF FISCAL YEAR 2027 FINANCIAL RESULTS
highlights: Forecasting second quarter of fiscal year 2027 revenue of $1.575 billion to $1.625 billion; non-GAAP operating margin of 45.0% to 46.0%; and non-GAAP diluted net income per share of $5.90 to $6.20.
Net revenue for the first quarter of fiscal year 2027 was $1.26 billion, with GAAP net income of $360.3 million, or $3.54 per diluted share.
GAAP gross margin of 51.0%; Non-GAAP gross margin of 53.2%
GAAP operating margin of 28.5%; Non-GAAP operating margin of 42.3%

quotes.text: Lumentum built on its strong momentum in the first fiscal quarter of 2027, delivering growth across all our businesses, with pump lasers and optical circuit switches (OCS) being the leading contributors. During the quarter, we secured our second major NPO/CPO win, backed by purchase commitments exceeding $5 billion.

outlook: Net revenue in the range of $1.575 billion to $1.625 billion
Non-GAAP diluted earnings per share of $5.90 to $6.20

items.heading: Our operating results may be adversely affected by unfavorable changes in macroeconomics and market conditions and the uncertain geopolitical environment.

Adverse changes in political, regulatory and economic policies, including the threats of increasing worldwide tariffs for goods imported into the United States and of escalating retaliatory measures, could adversely affect our business and results of operations.

We depend on a limited number of suppliers for raw materials, packages and components, and any failure or delay by these suppliers in meeting our requirements could have an adverse effect on our business and results of operations.
Our financial results may be adversely affected due to changes in product demand impacted by recessions, increases in interest rates, stagflation and other economic conditions.
Inflation and increased borrowing costs could impact our cash flows and profitability.
Our backlog may not be an accurate indicator of our level and timing of future revenues.
